description: Booking platforms to look a business up on when their own website cannot answer the question. Answers the single most valuable fact about a prospect: are they already booking online? A business FOUND on one of these is a WORSE prospect — they have an incumbent — so a false positive here costs a good lead, and a false negative costs a wasted phone call.
verificationNote: searchUrlTemplate values are UNVERIFIED. They were written without being able to reach these sites, so the first real run must confirm each one before its results are trusted. A template that 404s or redirects is reported as 'unavailable' rather than 'not found', so an unverified pattern cannot quietly mark every business as having no booking.

matching.notes: Both conditions must hold. Salon names repeat constantly across a state — there are dozens of 'Hair Studio' listings in Florida alone — so a name match without a city match is not evidence of anything.
